main.summary: Validates, publishes, and verifies the durable artifacts that make up a data publication.

field.name: SHA512MetadataKey
field.summary: Blob metadata key containing the hexadecimal SHA-512 digest of a published object.

field.name: LengthMetadataKey
field.summary: Blob metadata key containing the invariant-culture length of a published object.

method.name: HasPublishConflictAsync
method.summary: Determines whether an existing catalog entry or published artifact conflicts with the expected publication.
method.param: Orleans grain factory used to resolve the catalog.
Storage silo containing the catalog and publication blobs.
Descriptor of the item being published.
Expected object and optional stream artifact metadata.
Blob identifier used to resolve the publication artifacts.
Optional trace identifier for catalog operations.
Optional span identifier for catalog operations.
Cancellation token.
method.returns: True when an existing catalog entry or artifact conflicts with the expectation; otherwise false.

method.name: PublishArtifactsAsync
method.summary: Publishes the object, optionally assembles the stream, and persists the integrity artifact.
method.param: Tenant-scoped storage used to publish the artifacts.
Staged object payload to publish.
Expected SHA-512 digest of the object payload.
Optional block plan used to assemble the stream artifact.
Indicates whether the stream artifact should be published.
Expected published stream length.
Expected integrity summary for the stream artifact.
Expected stream integrity segments.
Cancellation token.
method.returns: True when all requested artifacts are published and verified; otherwise false.

method.name: CreateIntegrityArtifact
method.summary: Creates the integrity artifact describing the published object and optional stream.
method.param: SHA-512 digest of the published object.
Optional stream integrity summary.
Optional stream integrity segments to validate against the summary.
method.returns: Integrity artifact containing the object digest and validated stream integrity data.
method.exception: Thrown when stream segments are supplied without a summary, the summary is invalid, or the segments do not match the summary.

method.name: VerifyObjectAsync
method.summary: Verifies a published object blob's length and SHA-512 metadata.
method.param: Object blob to inspect.
Expected object length.
Expected object SHA-512 digest.
Cancellation token.
method.returns: True when the blob metadata matches the expected object; otherwise false.

method.name: VerifyIntegrityAsync
method.summary: Verifies that an integrity blob contains the expected serialized payload.
method.param: Integrity blob to download.
Expected serialized integrity payload.
Cancellation token.
method.returns: True when the stored payload matches the expected payload; otherwise false.

method.name: VerifyMetadata
method.summary: Verifies the object length and SHA-512 metadata stored on a blob.
method.param: Blob properties containing content length and metadata.
Expected object SHA-512 digest.
Expected object length.
method.returns: True when the properties match the expected values; otherwise false.

method.name: UpdateCatalogAsync
method.summary: Adds or updates the catalog entry for a successfully published item.
method.param: Orleans grain factory used to resolve the catalog.
Storage silo containing the catalog.
Published item descriptor.
Optional trace identifier for the catalog operation.
Optional span identifier for the catalog operation.
Cancellation token.
